title: FlowDoc Core Backend Editor Readiness Pass 8h
summary: Execute an eight-hour bounded readiness pass before deeper Editor/frontend implementation, starting by reconciling Core fixture state, proving the Backend owner gate against the actual sibling Core checkout, adding bounded Editor live Backend rich-inline harness evidence, defining the Editor text-block authoring boundary, adding memory-only active text-block island runtime state, wiring that state into the Editor Backend mutation lifecycle, adding an Editor-owned active text-block island commit runner with live Backend proof, and adding an Editor-owned node placement readiness matrix before visible typing UI or add-node mutation activation.
